stories.title: Burst water main closes A494 for the day between New Brighton and Ewloe
stories.summary: The A494 will be closed eastbound between New Brighton and junction 33B at Ewloe throughout the day after a burst water main, Traffic Wales has said. stories.title: Coastguard and lifeboat tasked after reports of two drifting boats at Greenfield Dock
stories.summary: Two boats reported drifting near Greenfield Dock on Monday afternoon turned out to be safely moored, Flint Coastguard Rescue Team said. stories.title: Monthly ketamine support sessions for parents launch at Penyffordd War Memorial Institute
stories.summary: A monthly support group for parents and carers worried about ketamine starts at Penyffordd War Memorial Institute on 3 September. stories.title: Flint Town Hall to host Adult Learners’ Week event on 21 September
stories.summary: An advice event on work, training and courses is being held at Flint Town Hall on Monday 21 September. It runs from 10am to 2pm. stories.title: Man dies after collision involving three cars on M56 in Cheshire
stories.summary: A pedestrian died after a collision involving three cars on the M56 eastbound between Hapsford and Runcorn in the early hours of Monday morning. Cheshire Police were called at around 12.50am, and paramedics also attended the scene between junction 14 and junction 12. The man, believed to be 38 and from Golborne, was pronounced dead
